description: The bar chart illustrates the number of tasks for different language groups, with the horizontal axis representing the number of tasks and the vertical axis listing the language groups. The x-axis is linear, ranging from 0 to 80, and the y-axis is categorical, listing the language groups. The bars are color-coded and represent the following language groups: IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque. The IE-Slavic group has the highest number of tasks, with a value close to 80, while the Basque group has the fewest tasks, with a value close to 0. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and there are no bars that are visually emphasized.
